content.text: **Summary**: I diagnosed ticket T-2009 by examining the crashing pricing-engine pods and their logs. The issue is not with Kubernetes, but with an application bug in the pricing-engine code—specifically an off-by-one error in tier indexing that gets triggered when compiling the "BF-2026-STACKED" pricing rule. The pods are correctly entering CrashLoopBackOff as expected when the application panics during startup. The fix requires the pricing-engine team to patch the tier lookup logic and deploy a new version.
